name: simplisafe-mcp
description: SimpliSafe home security for Claude — check system state and sensors, review events, arm/disarm, and control smart locks

simplisafe_refresh_token.title: SimpliSafe Refresh Token
simplisafe_refresh_token.description: Minted by the one-time browser login: run `node scripts/bootstrap-auth.mjs` in the repo and follow its two steps. SimpliSafe issues no API keys, so this token is the credential.

tools.name: simplisafe_list_systems
tools.description: List systems on the account with current alarm state

tools.name: simplisafe_get_system
tools.description: Get one system's state, connectivity and base-station messages

tools.name: simplisafe_get_settings
tools.description: Get entry/exit delays, alarm volume and base-station health

tools.name: simplisafe_list_sensors
tools.description: List sensors with battery, offline and triggered status

tools.name: simplisafe_list_locks
tools.description: List smart locks with locked/unlocked/jammed state

tools.name: simplisafe_set_lock_state
tools.description: Lock or unlock a smart lock (confirm-gated)
